column7: AWSSecretsManagerConnector had no response-size bound; a gzip-bombed backend response (~2 MiB compressed) forced ~4 GiB peak heap via transparent decompression with err=nil; fixed by hardened_client.go's sizeCappedRoundTripper capping the decompressed body at connectMaxResponseBytes; see docs/findings/2026-09-19-FINDING-connect-response-trust-gaps.md §3
